# Draft:Heritage Buildings of Department of Posts, Government of India

The Department of Posts (also known as India Post) is a part of the [https://services.india.gov.in/service/ministry_services?ln=en&cmd_id=344 Ministry of Communications, Government of India]. India Post is a custodian of rich heritage of postal buildings that echo the historical evolution and architectural grandeur of bygone eras. The origin of this vast postal network can be traced back to the year 1727, when the first Post Office was set up in Kolkata. These structures, spread across various regions, are not only functional assets but also represent the historical evolution of India’s architectural landscape. India Post has so far declared [https://www.indiapost.gov.in/VAS/DOP_PDFFiles/annual_report_2023_english.pdf 44 postal buildings as buildings of heritage importance] (Table 19).
